headline: Zeeshan Ali set to become the first Pakistani astronaut in orbit aboard China's Shenzhou 24
label: NEWS
caption:
Pakistan is about to make space history 🚀🇵🇰

Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has been named to the crew of China's Shenzhou 24 mission, set to become the first Pakistani astronaut to fly into orbit, according to Xinhua and Dawn.

He will fly alongside Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo, the mission commander, and Wu Yi. He will also be the first foreign astronaut ever to visit China's Tiangong space station.

The launch is scheduled for Wednesday at 8:18 am Beijing time (5:18 am in Pakistan) from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. Zeeshan will serve as a payload specialist, carrying out scientific experiments for Pakistan during a short stay of about a week.
